evidence_items.explanation: ACCORD finds commonsense reasoning becoming unreliable as reasoning complexity increases in GPT-4o, Llama 3 and Mixtral. This supports the reliability concern, but does not test all three capabilities or isolate what pretraining alone supplied.

evidence_items.locator: Experimental results, Performance of Multimodal Large Language Models
evidence_items.explanation: ContPhy reports some physical-reasoning strengths alongside substantial weaknesses, especially with deformable objects. These multimodal evaluations caution against an absolute absence claim but do not isolate ordinary text-only language-model training.

evidence_items.publisher: Wes Gurnee and Max Tegmark, arXiv
evidence_items.explanation: The study identifies structured spatial and temporal information in Llama 2 representations. It predates the target window and does not establish reliable physical dynamics, but weighs against interpreting 'none' as no learned world structure whatsoever.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved evaluations do not jointly establish all three capabilities under a consistent reliability criterion.
Training disclosures and experimental controls do not isolate ordinary language-model training from additional capability-specific training.
Structured representations and task successes do not settle whether a model possesses a reliable, usable world model.
ACCORD identifies its tested model versions and submission date, but not an exact experiment date; its event date is therefore recorded only to the year.
